**Functional summary:** This 493-aa protein is most consistent with a **bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme (Nnr)**. The proposed activities are NAD(P)HX epimerase (EC 5.1.99.6) and ADP-dependent NAD(P)HX dehydratase (EC 4.2.1.136): the enzyme can convert the R hydrate to the S form, then dehydrate the S form to restore NADH or NADPH, using ADP and producing AMP and phosphate.

**Evidence and properties:** Three reviewed Nnr homologs match at about 32% sequence identity, with 95–99% query coverage. The sequence also matches YjeF_N (residues 1–177) and Carb_kinase (237–487) Pfam domains. Its estimated molecular mass is 52.24 kDa and theoretical pI is 8.64. Homolog annotations report potassium binding and roles in metabolite repair and nicotinamide nucleotide metabolism.

This is a **homology-supported prediction**, not experimental confirmation for the supplied protein. Localization and organism-specific pathway context are not established by the available evidence.
